candidate_flag.reason: Boronophenylalanine is a boron delivery agent whose antitumour effect needs neutron irradiation (BNCT); counted as a drug-device candidate (device_dependent), but it could also be viewed as part of a radiation modality.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic parameters(AUClast) of borono-phenylalanine in subjects with recurrent high-grade glioma

role_evidence.quote: 500 mg/kg of the study drug is intravenously administered over 3 hours at a constant rate and neutron irradiation starts at 1 hour after the end of the study drug administration

agents.drug_class_hint: boron-10 carrier (BPA) for boron neutron capture therapy

coder_notes: BNCT: BPA infusion followed by neutron irradiation (device); coded as drug-device candidate with device_dependent true, regimen combination because neutron irradiation is radiotherapy. Phase IIa recruits IDH-wildtype glioblastoma (brief summary) while Phase I also allows IDH-mutant grade 3/4 gliomas, hence mixed_glioma_gbm_named. The three arms are radiation dose levels with no control. PK sample type not stated (blood concentration is used for irradiation time).
